utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Good morning to everyone. Mr. Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is case number IT-00-39-T, the Prosecutor versus Momcilo Krajisnik. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Registrar. Resulting from yesterday's decision on protective measures for the next witness to be called, I'd like to turn into closed session, unless there's anything to be raised prior to calling the witness. There's not. Could we please turn into closed session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Thursday, the 23rd of June, 2005, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.43 p.m.,
